name: @nshiab/journalism-format
description: Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on easily formatting numbers, dates, and more.

tasks.all-tests: deno install && deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check src/index.ts && deno doc --lint src/index.ts && deno publish --allow-dirty --dry-run && deno task test && deno task test-time-zones && deno task llm
tasks.test-time-zones: EXPECTED_SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE=UTC TZ=UTC deno test -A --fail-fast test/format/formatDateTZ.test.ts && EXPECTED_SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE=America/Vancouver TZ=America/Vancouver deno test -A --fail-fast test/format/formatDateTZ.test.ts
tasks.llm: deno run -A jsr:@nshiab/deno-docs-to-md && deno fmt llm.md
tasks.patch: deno task all-tests && deno run -A jsr:@nshiab/bump-version patch
tasks.minor: deno task all-tests && deno run -A jsr:@nshiab/bump-version minor
tasks.major: deno task all-tests && deno run -A jsr:@nshiab/bump-version major
